say:1:1061901001:1.text: I always thought that the Adamant Syndicate were all serious businessmen. I didn't realize that they were thugs that harassed villagers!
say:1:1061901001:1.source_cn: 我一直以为黑金商会都是正经的生意人，只不过价格高了点，...
say:1:1061901001:1.male: I always thought that the Adamant Syndicate were all serious businessmen. I didn't realize that they were thugs that harassed villagers!
say:1:1061901001:1.female: I always thought that the Adamant Syndicate were all serious businessmen. I didn't realize that they were thugs that harassed villagers!

say:2:1061901002:1.text: I don't understand how a tiny village like Slopeville is any of their concern.
say:2:1061901002:1.source_cn: 我真不明白，像我们南坡村这种小村子，到底是哪里招惹他们了？
